projects_row_level.name: projects_row_level
projects_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  p.total_cost AS total_cost,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  p.ec_ref AS ec_ref,
  p.ec_call AS ec_call,
  p.framework_program AS framework_program
FROM projects p
projects_row_level.description: Canonical, cleaned row-level projection of the projects table exposing key identifiers, dates, and cost measures for reuse in filtering, joining, and aggregation.

projects_with_principal_investigator.name: projects_with_principal_investigator
projects_with_principal_investigator.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.principal_investigator,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  pp.programme
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_principal_investigator.description: Denormalized view joining projects to principal investigator (people) and to programme and funding scheme identifiers where available. One row per project with PI id and basic programme/funding references for richer filters and aggregations.

project_members_cohort.name: project_members_cohort
project_members_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_cohort.description: Row-level cohort of project members exposing project id, institution id, member name, role, country and contribution amounts to allow filtering by participating organizations or contribution totals per project.

projects_rowlevel.name: projects_rowlevel
projects_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id::integer AS unics_id,
  p.title::text AS title,
  -- canonicalize dates: keep as date or NULL
  CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN p.start_date::date ELSE NULL END AS start_date,
  CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN p.end_date::date ELSE NULL END AS end_date,
  -- canonicalize years: integer or NULL
  CASE WHEN p.start_year IS NOT NULL THEN p.start_year::integer ELSE NULL END AS start_year,
  CASE WHEN p.end_year IS NOT NULL THEN p.end_year::integer ELSE NULL END AS end_year,
  -- numeric cost measures: ensure numeric type (double precision) or NULL
  CASE WHEN p.total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN p.total_cost::double precision ELSE NULL END AS total_cost,
  CASE WHEN p.ec_max_contribution IS NOT NULL THEN p.ec_max_contribution::double precision ELSE NULL END AS ec_max_contribution,
  p.acronym::text AS acronym,
  p.ec_ref::text AS ec_ref,
  p.cordis_ref::text AS cordis_ref
FROM projects p
projects_rowlevel.description: One row per project with canonicalized numeric and date measures; exposes identity, title, timeline and cost measures without aggregating so downstream queries can filter or aggregate as needed.
counter_examples: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year

project_basic_financials.name: project_basic_financials
project_basic_financials.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM projects_rowlevel p
project_basic_financials.description: Per-project basic financial measures (no further breakdown). This groups at project level and exposes raw sums/primary financial fields so that consumers can compute totals or combine with other financial aggregates. It is intentionally a project-level measure rollup to support queries that ask for project totals or comparisons.

project_title_index.name: project_title_index
project_title_index.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.acronym
FROM
  projects_rowlevel p
project_title_index.description: Simple lookup relation mapping project title to project id and key identifiers to support title exact-match lookups and disambiguation.

project_dates_cohort.name: project_dates_cohort
project_dates_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM projects p
project_dates_cohort.description: Cohort / subset of projects exposing project id and start/end dates for date-based filtering and year-based grouping. Useful for time-window filtering across queries.
validated_on: Count the projects that started in 2016

project_acronym_presence.name: project_acronym_presence
project_acronym_presence.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym
FROM
  projects_rowlevel p
WHERE
  p.acronym IS NOT NULL
project_acronym_presence.description: Subset of projects that have a non-null acronym; exposes project id and acronym for queries that need projects with defined acronyms.

project_start_year_cohort.name: project_start_year_cohort
project_start_year_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.start_date,
  COALESCE(p.start_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer) AS start_year
FROM
  projects p
WHERE
  -- lift year literal OUT: use NULL to indicate include all years by default;
  -- callers can add WHERE start_year = <year> when selecting from this view.
  (p.start_date IS NOT NULL OR p.start_year IS NOT NULL)
project_start_year_cohort.description: Project rows annotated or filtered by start_date-derived year. Provides a selectable cohort of projects by calendar year of start_date (exposes start_year/year derived from start_date where available).

project_membership_summary.name: project_membership_summary
project_membership_summary.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.country,
  pm.ec_contribution
FROM
  project_members_cohort pm
project_membership_summary.description: Denormalized membership info per project-member combination linking projects to their members and institutions. Exposes project id, member id, institution id, member role, country and monetary contribution to support queries that need membership-derived filters or aggregations.

project_participants.name: project_participants
project_participants.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  pm.ec_contribution AS "project_members.ec_contribution",
  pm.country AS "project_members.country",
  pm.region_code AS "project_members.region_code"
FROM project_members pm
project_participants.description: Denormalized project-member mapping: one row per project-member participation exposing project id, member/institution ids, role and member-level geographic info and EC contribution. Useful for queries that filter projects by participants or aggregate contributions by project.

project_with_programme_and_topics.name: project_with_programme_and_topics
project_with_programme_and_topics.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS "project (projects.unics_id)",
  p.title AS "projects.title",
  pp.programme AS "project_programmes.programme",
  psa.subject_area AS "project_subject_areas.subject_area",
  pt.topic AS "project_topics.topic"
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_subject_areas psa ON psa.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_topics pt ON pt.project = p.unics_id
project_with_programme_and_topics.description: Project-level rows enriched with associated programme, subject areas and topics. One row per (project, programme) or (project, subject_area) or (project, topic) depending on join; intended to support filtering by programme/subject/topic or to be aggregated to project-level.

projects_rowlevel_12.name: projects_rowlevel_12
projects_rowlevel_12.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  -- lift literal mapping of ec_fund_scheme values OUT of the view:
  -- supply ec_fund_scheme directly from projects_with_principal_investigator when available
  COALESCE(ppi.ec_fund_scheme, p.ec_fund_scheme) AS ec_fund_scheme,
  -- framework_program: prefer normalized framework_program from projects_with_principal_investigator, fall back to projects table
  COALESCE(ppi.framework_program, p.framework_program) AS framework_program
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator ppi
  ON p.unics_id = ppi.unics_id
projects_rowlevel_12.description: Row-level canonical view of projects exposing core identifiers, dates, title and funding info for filtering and downstream aggregation.

project_basic_projection.name: project_basic_projection
project_basic_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  pr.unics_id,
  trim(both ' ' FROM coalesce(pr.title, pti.title, '') ) AS title,
  -- ensure start_date is of type date; lift literal handling to source views if needed
  CAST(pr.start_date AS date) AS start_date
FROM
  projects_row_level pr
LEFT JOIN
  project_title_index pti
ON
  pr.unics_id = pti.unics_id
project_basic_projection.description: Normalized projection of projects with cleaned canonical title and explicit date cast columns to ensure consistent types for date comparisons and text trimming.

project_member_regions_lookup.name: project_member_regions_lookup
project_member_regions_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3,
  pm.region_name AS region_name
FROM
  project_members pm
project_member_regions_lookup.description: Denormalized mapping of project_members' institution-level identifiers and region fields. Exposes project_member unics_id and institution_id alongside region_name and geocode_regions_3. Included because project_members contain a region_name column that can be compared with institutions.region fields when needed for cross-checks or reconciliation in future questions.

projects_core.name: projects_core
projects_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,

  p.end_date,

FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pwpi

validated_on: Show me the number of projects where Thomas Bell was principal investigator

people_core.body_sql:

project_principal_investigator_link.name: project_principal_investigator_link
project_principal_investigator_link.body_sql:
SELECT

subject_area_definitions.name: subject_area_definitions
subject_area_definitions.body_sql:

project_subject_area_links.name: project_subject_area_links
project_subject_area_links.body_sql:
SELECT

  project_subject_areas.subject_area AS subject_area

project_subject_area_links.description: Mapping of projects to subject area codes. One row per project-subject_area membership, exposing project id and subject area code for filtering and joins to project metadata.

project_subject_area_assignments.name: project_subject_area_assignments
project_subject_area_assignments.body_sql:
SELECT
  psa.project                                    AS project_unics_id,
  p.acronym                                      AS acronym,
  psa.subject_area                               AS subject_area_code,
  sa.title                                        AS subject_area_title,
  sa.description                                  AS subject_area_description
FROM project_subject_areas psa
LEFT JOIN projects p
  ON p.unics_id = psa.project
LEFT JOIN subject_areas sa
  ON sa.code = psa.subject_area
project_subject_area_assignments.description: One row per project-subject_area assignment linking projects to subject area metadata (exposes project id, project acronym, subject area code and subject area title/description). Useful for filtering projects by subject area and returning project attributes alongside subject area details.

projects_core_22.name: projects_core_22
projects_core_22.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id                                AS unics_id,
  COALESCE(p.acronym, pr.acronym)           AS acronym,
  COALESCE(pr.title, p.title)               AS title,
  p.start_date                              AS start_date,
  p.end_date                                AS end_date,
  p.start_year                              AS start_year,
  p.end_year                                AS end_year,
  pi.principal_investigator                 AS principal_investigator,
  pi.ec_fund_scheme                         AS ec_fund_scheme,
  COALESCE(pi.framework_program, p.framework_program) AS framework_program
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_rowlevel pr
  ON pr.unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pi
  ON pi.unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_core_22.description: Canonical project rows with key identifiers and commonly used attributes normalized/cleaned (exposes project id, acronym, title, start/end dates/years, principal investigator, funding scheme, framework). Useful as the base project entity for many queries.

subject_areas_dim.name: subject_areas_dim
subject_areas_dim.body_sql:
SELECT
  sa.code AS code,
  sa.title AS title,
  sa.description AS description
FROM
  subject_areas sa
subject_areas_dim.description: Canonical subject area dimension exposing code, title, and description for use in filtering and labeling. Useful for any query that needs subject area metadata.

projects_core_24.name: projects_core_24
projects_core_24.body_sql:
SELECT

  p.acronym,

projects_core_24.description: One-row-per-project core project attributes and dates for filtering and joins.

project_topic_links.name: project_topic_links
project_topic_links.body_sql:
SELECT
  pt.project::integer AS project,
  pt.topic::text AS topic
FROM project_topics pt
project_topic_links.description: Mapping of projects to topic codes (one row per project-topic association).
validated_on: Find distinct titles of topics of projects that with end year 2014

topics_dim.name: topics_dim
topics_dim.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(t.title, ''), NULLIF(t.title_trimmed, ''), t.code) AS title,
  t.rcn AS rcn
FROM (
  SELECT
    code,
    -- prefer topics.title; if null/empty, use topics.rcn trimmed; otherwise fallback to code
    title,
    NULLIF(btrim(rcn), '') AS rcn,
    -- trimmed rcn fallback as a candidate for title when title is empty
    NULLIF(btrim(rcn), '') AS title_trimmed
  FROM topics
) t
topics_dim.description: Canonical topic definitions and display title.
validated_on: Find distinct titles of topics of projects that with end year 2014
Show me topic titles which starts with 'Raw materials'
counter_examples: Show me topic titles which contain the word 'climate'

projects_row_level_27.name: projects_row_level_27
projects_row_level_27.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_title_index pti USING (unics_id)
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pwpi USING (unics_id)

projects_with_members_denormalized.name: projects_with_members_denormalized
projects_with_members_denormalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project::integer AS project,
  pjl.unics_id AS projects_unics_id,
  pjl.acronym AS acronym,
  pm.unics_id AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,

JOIN projects_rowlevel pjl
  ON pm.project = pjl.unics_id
projects_with_members_denormalized.description: Denormalized one-row-per-project-member join that attaches project basic attributes to each project member row to simplify queries that need project info for member cohorts.

institutions_core.name: institutions_core
institutions_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical institution name: prefer cleaned institutions_name; fall back to member-provided name if present.
  COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(institutions.institutions_name), ''), NULLIF(trim(pm.member_name), '')) AS institutions_name,
  institutions.unics_id,
  -- canonical country FK: prefer institutions.country_id; if null, try to resolve from project member country text via countries table (lifted literal for join)
  COALESCE(
    institutions.country_id,
    countries.unics_id
  ) AS country_id,
  institutions.acronym,
  institutions.short_name,
  institutions.website,
  institutions.geocode_regions_3
FROM institutions
-- left join to project_members cohort to surface an alternative member_name and potential country text when institutions.country_id is null.
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (institution_id)
    institution_id,
    member_name,
    country
  FROM project_members
  WHERE institution_id IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY institution_id, member_name
) pm ON pm.institution_id = institutions.unics_id
-- left join to countries to resolve textual country from project_members.country to countries.unics_id
LEFT JOIN countries ON countries.country_name = pm.country
WHERE institutions.unics_id IS NOT NULL
institutions_core.description: Canonical institution rows with core identifying columns and cleaned name/country references. Exposes one row per institution with standardized name and country foreign key for joining.

countries_core.body_sql:

FROM
  countries
countries_core.description: Canonical country rows with primary id and common name/codes for lookups and joins.

institutions_with_country.name: institutions_with_country
institutions_with_country.body_sql:
SELECT

  institutions.country_id AS "institutions.country_id",
  countries.unics_id AS "countries.unics_id",

  institutions.acronym AS "institutions.acronym",
  institutions.short_name AS "institutions.short_name",

FROM institutions
LEFT JOIN countries

institutions_core_32.name: institutions_core_32
institutions_core_32.body_sql:
SELECT
  institutions_name::text AS institutions_name,

  geocode_regions_3::text AS geocode_regions_3,

institutions_with_country_33.name: institutions_with_country_33
institutions_with_country_33.body_sql:
SELECT

  institutions.institutions_name,

  countries.country_code2,
  countries.country_code3,

FROM institutions

institutions_with_country_33.description: Denormalized institution-level view joining institutions to countries so each row includes institution info plus the linked country's name and codes. Useful for filtering institutions by country or grouping by country.

projects_row_level_34.name: projects_row_level_34
projects_row_level_34.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id::integer AS unics_id,
  p.acronym::text AS acronym,
  p.title::text AS title,
  p.start_year::integer AS start_year,
  p.start_date::date AS start_date,
  p.end_year::integer AS end_year,

FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pwpi

projects_row_level_34.description: Normalized row-level view of projects exposing primary identifiers and key date/cost/funding fields for filtering and aggregation. Keeps one row per project and preserves raw values (no aggregation).

projects_core_36.name: projects_core_36
projects_core_36.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  p.total_cost AS total_cost,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,

projects_core_36.description: Core row-level project records with key identifiers and primary numeric/temporal fields exposed for filtering, sorting, and aggregation.

project_financials_by_programme.name: project_financials_by_programme
project_financials_by_programme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  COALESCE(f.total_cost, p.total_cost) AS total_cost,
  COALESCE(f.ec_max_contribution, p.ec_max_contribution) AS ec_max_contribution,
  COALESCE(pp.programme, NULL) AS programme
FROM projects_rowlevel AS p
LEFT JOIN project_basic_financials AS f
  ON f.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator AS pp
  ON pp.unics_id = p.unics_id
project_financials_by_programme.description: Project financials combined with programme linkage; one row per project with programme code to support program-level filtering or grouping while keeping raw financial measures.

project_members_core.name: project_members_core
project_members_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.activity_type,
  pm.country,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.member_short_name
FROM project_members pm
project_members_core.description: Canonical projection of project_members with keys and identifying attributes for members and linkage to projects and institutions. One row per project member.

members_with_project_financials.name: members_with_project_financials
members_with_project_financials.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id AS project_unics_id",
  p.total_cost AS "projects.total_cost"
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  projects p
ON
  pm.project = p.unics_id
members_with_project_financials.description: Denormalized view joining project_members to projects to expose each member alongside their project's financial measures. One row per project member (member record) with project total_cost.

project_members_row_level.name: project_members_row_level
project_members_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution
FROM project_members pm
project_members_row_level.description: Normalized row-level view of project_members exposing each project-person membership with canonical columns and no aggregation. Cleans nothing that is question-specific; keeps raw identifiers and key attributes used for filtering/grouping.

project_member_counts_per_project.name: project_member_counts_per_project
project_member_counts_per_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project                                   AS project,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id)                 AS distinct_member_count,
  COUNT(*)                                     AS total_member_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.institution_id)           AS distinct_institution_count,
  SUM(pm.ec_contribution)                     AS sum_ec_contribution
FROM
  project_members_cohort pm
GROUP BY
  pm.project
project_member_counts_per_project.description: Per-project aggregated counts of distinct members and basic membership measures. Computes distinct member count per project to support thresholds and ordering.

projects_row_level_42.name: projects_row_level_42
projects_row_level_42.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  -- expose funding scheme code as stored on projects table for joins/grouping
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.framework_program
FROM projects p
projects_row_level_42.description: Canonical row-level projects relation with cleaned identifiers and the funding scheme code exposed for joins and grouping. Each row is one project from the projects table.

funding_schemes_dim.name: funding_schemes_dim
funding_schemes_dim.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code AS code,
  fs.title AS title,
  NULL::text AS description
FROM funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_dim.description: Canonical funding schemes dimension exposing scheme code and human title for joins and presentation.

projects_by_funding_scheme.name: projects_by_funding_scheme
projects_by_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
  COUNT(p.unics_id) AS project_count
FROM projects_with_principal_investigator p
GROUP BY p.ec_fund_scheme
projects_by_funding_scheme.description: Counts of projects grouped by funding scheme code (one row per funding scheme code). Provides the raw count measure used for top-k queries and comparisons.

projects_row_level_45.name: projects_row_level_45
projects_row_level_45.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  COALESCE(p.acronym, pti.acronym) AS acronym,
  COALESCE(p.title, pti.title) AS title,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  pb.total_cost AS total_cost,
  pb.ec_max_contribution AS ec_max_contribution,
  COALESCE(p.framework_program, pwpi.framework_program) AS framework_program,
  pwpi.principal_investigator AS principal_investigator
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_basic_financials pb
  ON pb.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pwpi
  ON pwpi.unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_title_index pti
  ON pti.unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_row_level_45.description: Canonical, cleaned project-level rows exposing project identifiers, dates, and raw monetary measures. NULLs are not aggregated here; keep one row per project for downstream aggregation and filtering.

project_financials_by_project.name: project_financials_by_project
project_financials_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  -- lift any literals: none needed
  p.total_cost AS total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution AS ec_max_contribution,
  (p.total_cost IS NULL) AS total_cost_is_null
FROM projects_rowlevel p
project_financials_by_project.description: Per-project financial measures normalized for analysis. Provides raw monetary fields and flags for presence of cost data; grouped at project (projects.unics_id) level so downstream queries can sum/avg across projects without re-aggregating incorrectly.

project_time_attributes.name: project_time_attributes
project_time_attributes.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  -- prefer explicit start_year if present; otherwise derive from start_date year; result as integer or NULL
  CASE
    WHEN p.start_year IS NOT NULL THEN p.start_year
    WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer
    ELSE NULL
  END AS start_year,
  -- prefer explicit end_year if present; otherwise derive from end_date year; result as integer or NULL
  CASE
    WHEN p.end_year IS NOT NULL THEN p.end_year
    WHEN p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer
    ELSE NULL
  END AS end_year,
  -- boolean flags indicating presence of an end year / start year
  (CASE
     WHEN (p.end_year IS NOT NULL) THEN true
     WHEN (p.end_date IS NOT NULL) THEN true
     ELSE false
   END) AS has_end_year,
  (CASE
     WHEN (p.start_year IS NOT NULL) THEN true
     WHEN (p.start_date IS NOT NULL) THEN true
     ELSE false
   END) AS has_start_year
FROM projects_row_level p
project_time_attributes.description: Project-level cohort exposing projects with computed/cleaned temporal attributes useful for time-based filtering (explicitly includes start_year and end_year as integers and flags for missing years).

project_with_program_and_scheme.name: project_with_program_and_scheme
project_with_program_and_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  COALESCE(pp.programme, projects_with_principal_investigator.programme) AS programme,
  COALESCE(projects_with_principal_investigator.ec_fund_scheme, p.ec_fund_scheme) AS ec_fund_scheme,
  ecp.ec_framework_program_name AS programme_title,
  fs.title AS funding_scheme_title
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator
  ON projects_with_principal_investigator.unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN ec_framework_programs ecp
  ON ecp.ec_framework_program_name = COALESCE(pp.programme, projects_with_principal_investigator.programme, p.framework_program)
LEFT JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON fs.code = COALESCE(projects_with_principal_investigator.ec_fund_scheme, p.ec_fund_scheme)
project_with_program_and_scheme.description: Denormalized project rows joined to programme and funding scheme metadata for filtering or grouping by programme/scheme.

projects_duration_derived.name: projects_duration_derived
projects_duration_derived.body_sql:
SELECT
  pr.unics_id,
  pr.start_year,
  pr.end_year,
  CASE
    WHEN pr.start_year IS NULL OR pr.end_year IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (pr.end_year - pr.start_year)
  END AS duration_years
FROM projects_row_level pr
projects_duration_derived.description: Per-project derived measure for duration in years (end_year - start_year). One row per project with duration computed. Null duration if either year is NULL.

projects_join_projects_members_instituti.name: projects_join_projects_members_institutions_basic
projects_join_projects_members_instituti.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym",
  p.title AS "projects.title",
  p.start_year AS "projects.start_year",
  p.end_year AS "projects.end_year",
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  i.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id",
  i.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  i.country_id AS "institutions.country_id"
FROM projects p
JOIN project_members pm
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN institutions i
  ON i.unics_id = pm.institution_id
projects_join_projects_members_instituti.description: Denormalized project-level row by joining projects to project_members and institutions to expose project identifiers together with member and institution references. Useful for questions that need project metadata plus membership/institution context.

topics_text_index.name: topics_text_index
topics_text_index.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title,
  lower(t.title) AS lowercase_title
FROM topics t
WHERE t.title IS NOT NULL
  AND t.title <> ''
topics_text_index.description: Subset/cohort of topics with normalized title text useful for case-insensitive searches and full-text matching. Keeps one row per topic with a computed lowercase_title field.

projects_with_principal_person.name: projects_with_principal_person
projects_with_principal_person.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
projects_with_principal_person.description: Denormalized join of projects to their principal investigator person record, one row per project including the PI's full name to support counts and filters by person.
validated_on: Show the title of projects with costs higher than 1000000

people_name_variants.name: people_name_variants
people_name_variants.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.full_name,
  -- simple normalization: lowercased, trimmed, internal spaces collapsed,
  -- remove punctuation characters that commonly vary in names, and
  -- compute a short lexical fingerprint as name_normalized.
  regexp_replace(
    trim(lower(p.full_name)),
    '\s+',
    ' ',
    'g'
  ) AS name_normalized
FROM
  people p
WHERE
  p.full_name IS NOT NULL
people_name_variants.description: Potential name variants and a canonicalization rank per person to support choosing preferred full_name when multiple representations exist (uses raw full_name text with a simple normalization score).

project_costs_cohort.name: project_costs_cohort
project_costs_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM projects_rowlevel p
WHERE p.unics_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (p.total_cost IS NOT NULL OR p.ec_max_contribution IS NOT NULL)
project_costs_cohort.description: Cohort view of projects with their cost-related measures and identifiers. Intended as a reusable filtered subset when answering cost-range or budget-related questions.

project_with_program_and_funding_scheme.name: project_with_program_and_funding_scheme
project_with_program_and_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.framework_program,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  -- lift literal joins out: programme code comes from projects.programme (here projects has 'framework_program' and projects_with_principal_investigator provides 'programme')
  -- prefer programme from projects_with_principal_investigator when available, otherwise NULL
  pwpi.programme AS program_code,
  ep.ec_framework_program_name AS programme_title,
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS funding_scheme_code,
  fs.title AS funding_scheme_title
FROM
  projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pwpi
  ON pwpi.unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN ec_framework_programs ep
  ON ep.ec_framework_program_name = pwpi.programme
LEFT JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON fs.code = p.ec_fund_scheme
project_with_program_and_funding_scheme.description: Denormalized project rows joined to programme and funding scheme metadata for richer filtering and labeling (keeps one row per project). Does LEFT JOINs so missing metadata does not drop projects.
validated_on: Find the code of the funding scheme for Framework Partnership Agreement

project_financials_by_project_56.name: project_financials_by_project_56
project_financials_by_project_56.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  -- is_budget_present: true if either total_cost or ec_max_contribution is non-null
  ( (p.total_cost IS NOT NULL) OR (p.ec_max_contribution IS NOT NULL) ) AS is_budget_present
FROM projects_rowlevel p
project_financials_by_project_56.description: Prepares per-project financial measures (raw values plus a flag for large budget projects) grouped at project level. Does NOT apply question-specific thresholds; exposes total_cost and ec_max_contribution for aggregations and filters downstream.

projects_row_level_57.name: projects_row_level_57
projects_row_level_57.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.total_cost,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  pwpi.ec_fund_scheme,
  pwpi.framework_program,
  pwpi.principal_investigator
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_with_principal_investigator pwpi
  ON p.unics_id = pwpi.unics_id
projects_row_level_57.description: Row-level canonical view of projects with core identifiers and raw numeric measures (no aggregation). Useful as the base cohort for filters like cost thresholds, year ranges, and joins to programme/members.

project_financials_canonical.name: project_financials_canonical
project_financials_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id::integer AS unics_id,
  p.title::text AS title,
  -- canonicalize numeric cost fields: prefer project's total_cost, fall back to aggregated financials if null
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(trim(both ' ' FROM p.total_cost::text),'')::double precision,
    NULLIF(trim(both ' ' FROM pf.total_cost::text),'')::double precision
  ) AS total_cost,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(trim(both ' ' FROM p.ec_max_contribution::text),'')::double precision,
    NULLIF(trim(both ' ' FROM pf.ec_max_contribution::text),'')::double precision
  ) AS ec_max_contribution,
  -- explicit boolean flag whether canonical total_cost is null
  (COALESCE(
     NULLIF(trim(both ' ' FROM p.total_cost::text),'')::double precision,
     NULLIF(trim(both ' ' FROM pf.total_cost::text),'')::double precision
   ) IS NULL) AS total_cost_is_null
FROM projects_rowlevel p
LEFT JOIN project_basic_financials pf
  ON pf.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
project_financials_canonical.description: Canonicalized financial measures and key identifiers for each project; casts and null-normalization for cost fields so downstream queries reliably compare numeric thresholds.

project_basic_with_programme.name: project_basic_with_programme
project_basic_with_programme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.total_cost,
  COALESCE(pp.programme, NULL) AS programme,
  p.framework_program AS framework_program
FROM
  projects_row_level p
LEFT JOIN
  projects_with_principal_investigator pp
  ON p.unics_id = pp.unics_id
project_basic_with_programme.description: Denormalized project row with its programme code (when present) to support filters or grouping by programme/framework alongside project attributes.

project_members_core_60.name: project_members_core_60
project_members_core_60.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS member_unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.city AS city,
  pm.latitude AS latitude,
  pm.longitude AS longitude
FROM project_members pm
project_members_core_60.description: Canonical projection of project member rows: one row per project-member with identifiers, member name, role, institution reference, contribution and location fields.

projects_with_members_denorm.name: projects_with_members_denorm
projects_with_members_denorm.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.title AS project_title,
  m.unics_id AS member_unics_id,
  m.member_name AS member_name,
  m.member_role AS member_role,
  m.institution_id AS institution_id,
  m.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution
FROM projects_row_level p
JOIN project_members_cohort m
  ON m.project = p.unics_id
grain: one row per project-member pairing (project unics_id + member unics_id)
projects_with_members_denorm.description: Denormalized rows combining projects and their members: one row per project-member pairing including project title and member name/role to support retrievals that list members per project.

projects_with_erc_research_domain_assign.name: projects_with_erc_research_domain_assignment
projects_with_erc_research_domain_assign.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.acronym AS project_acronym,
  p.title AS project_title,
  erc_research_domains.code AS erc_domain_code
FROM projects p
JOIN project_erc_panels pep ON pep.project = p.unics_id
JOIN erc_panels ep ON ep.code = pep.panel
JOIN erc_research_domains ON erc_research_domains.code = ep.part_of
projects_with_erc_research_domain_assign.description: Denormalized view linking projects to ERC research domain codes where available. One row per project × domain assignment. Exposes project id, project identifying columns, and the research domain code to enable filtering, grouping, or joining with domain descriptions.

erc_domain_project_counts_by_year.name: erc_domain_project_counts_by_year
erc_domain_project_counts_by_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  pr.code AS erc_domain_code,
  p.start_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.unics_id) AS project_count
FROM projects_row_level p
JOIN project_erc_panels pep ON pep.project = p.unics_id
JOIN erc_research_domains pr ON pr.code = pep.panel
WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pr.code, p.start_year
erc_domain_project_counts_by_year.description: Counts of projects per ERC research domain per project start year. Aggregated measures useful for trend analyses and top-n by domain/year. Keeps raw counts (no thresholds) so callers can apply filters or ordering.

institutions_with_country_name.name: institutions_with_country_name
institutions_with_country_name.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  c.unics_id AS country_id,
  c.country_name
FROM institutions i
JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_name.description: Denormalized institution rows joined to their country record, returning only institutions that have a matching country. One row per institution (only those with matching country).

countries_by_name_lookup.name: countries_by_name_lookup
countries_by_name_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.unics_id,
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code2,
  c.country_code3
FROM
  countries c
countries_by_name_lookup.description: Search/cohort view of countries exposing normalized name variants and primary keys to support name-based lookup and filtering (one row per country).

funding_schemes_core.name: funding_schemes_core
funding_schemes_core.description: One-row-per-funding-scheme basic projection exposing the scheme primary key and human-readable title for filtering and joins.

funding_scheme_title_lookup.name: funding_scheme_title_lookup
funding_scheme_title_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code AS code,
  fs.title AS title,
  -- canonicalized title: lowercased, trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed to single space
  regexp_replace(trim(lower(fs.title)), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS title_canonical
FROM
  funding_schemes fs
funding_scheme_title_lookup.description: Normalized lookup of funding schemes with trimmed/canonicalized title to support case/whitespace-insensitive matching.

programmes_core.name: programmes_core
programmes_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  code,
  COALESCE(short_name, '') AS short_name,
  title,
  parent
FROM programmes
programmes_core.description: Normalized canonical projection of programme records exposing identifier, short name and full title for reuse in joins and lookups.

ec_framework_programs_lookup.name: ec_framework_programs_lookup
ec_framework_programs_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  ec_framework_program_name
FROM
  ec_framework_programs
ORDER BY
  ec_framework_program_name
ec_framework_programs_lookup.description: Row-level listing of EC framework program names; useful as a lookup when mapping programme titles or providing fallback names.

programme_to_ecframework_candidates.name: programme_to_ecframework_candidates
programme_to_ecframework_candidates.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.code AS code,
  p.short_name AS short_name,
  -- prefer programme.title when present, otherwise fall back to ec_framework_programs.ec_framework_program_name
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.title, ''), ef.ec_framework_program_name) AS title,
  ef.ec_framework_program_name AS ec_framework_program_name
FROM programmes p
LEFT JOIN ec_framework_programs ef
  ON p.title IS NULL OR p.title = ''
  -- match by programme.code to framework name when programme.title missing:
  -- lift literal comparison out: no literals to parameterize here beyond empty string
  -- try to match programme.code to ec_framework_program_name when title missing
  AND ef.ec_framework_program_name = p.code
UNION
-- include programmes that already have titles but still want the ec_framework_program_name when it exists for reference
SELECT
  p2.code AS code,
  p2.short_name AS short_name,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p2.title, ''), ef2.ec_framework_program_name) AS title,
  ef2.ec_framework_program_name AS ec_framework_program_name
FROM programmes p2
LEFT JOIN ec_framework_programs ef2
  ON ef2.ec_framework_program_name = p2.code
programme_to_ecframework_candidates.description: Denormalized view combining programmes with EC framework program names where available. Useful for resolving full programme title and for fallback to ec_framework_programs when programme title is missing.

project_members_rowlevel.name: project_members_rowlevel
project_members_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.city AS city,
  pm.postal_code AS postal_code,
  pm.latitude AS latitude,
  pm.longitude AS longitude
FROM project_members pm
project_members_rowlevel.description: One row per project member with all raw project-member attributes (cohort of project_members rows). Useful as the base cohort for filtering by project, member attributes, or joining to projects/institutions/people.

project_members_with_project.name: project_members_with_project
project_members_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id AS project_unics_id",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym AS project_acronym"
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  projects p
ON
  pm.project = p.unics_id
project_members_with_project.description: Denormalized rows joining project_members to their projects (one row per project_members.unics_id) to enable queries that filter by project attributes (e.g., project acronym) while exposing member fields.
